# NeuralNg Switch

IMPORT
import { NeuralSwitch, type NeuralSwitchChange } from '@neural-ng/core/switch';

RULES
- Use <neural-switch [(checked)]="state">Visible label</neural-switch>.
- NeuralSwitch implements FormCheckboxControl.
- checked is boolean. Switch has no tri-state or null value.
- checkedChange is generated by the checked model for two-way binding.
- stateChange is the detailed user-only output: { checked, previousChecked, nativeEvent }.
- Bind with [formField], [formControl], or [(ngModel)]; do not add a ControlValueAccessor or a second value store.
- Programmatic checked updates do not emit stateChange. User changes emit exactly one stateChange.
- The component retains a native input[type="checkbox"] with role="switch".
- Project a visible label whenever possible. If there is no projected label, provide ariaLabel.
- onLabel and offLabel are optional visual track text and do not provide the accessible name.
- touch emits when the native input blurs.
- readonly stays focusable, exposes aria-readonly, and blocks changes.
- disabled removes the switch from interaction and the tab order.
- Use neural-tri-state-checkbox instead when boolean | null is required.
- Set unstyled for local headless mode or provideNeuralNg({ unstyled: true }) globally.
- Consumer classes and structural hooks survive unstyled mode.
- Inside neural-field, Switch inherits id, descriptions, required, invalid, disabled, readonly, fluid, and unstyled state.

FORMS
<neural-switch [formField]="form.notifications">Signal notifications</neural-switch>
<neural-switch [formControl]="notificationsControl">Reactive notifications</neural-switch>
<neural-switch name="notifications" [(ngModel)]="notifications">Template notifications</neural-switch>

EXAMPLE
<neural-switch
  [(checked)]="notifications"
  onLabel="On"
  offLabel="Off"
  (stateChange)="notificationsChanged($event)"
>
  Notifications
</neural-switch>

CLASS SLOTS
root, input, track, checkedTrack, thumb, label, onLabel, offLabel

COMPATIBILITY
- SwitchComponent is a deprecated alias. Generate NeuralSwitch in new code.
